title: Gas Benchmarking — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Gas Benchmarking solution should meet the objective: Capture reproducible gas measurements for two equivalent implementations under identical compiler and optimizer settings, then explain trade-offs. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
